map.输入整层水汽通量与抬升指数（LI），结合水汽条件与大气稳定度估算降水发生概率和量: Enter the column-integrated water vapor flux and the lifted index (LI) to estimate the probability and magnitude of precipitation, combining moisture conditions and atmospheric stability.
map.📖 查看「降水概率估计 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Precipitation Probability Estimation User Guide"
map.抬升指数 LI (°C，负值不稳定): Lifted index LI (°C, negative means unstable)
map.💡 降水概率 P = clamp(40 + 1.5·Q - 8·LI, 5, 9: 💡 Precipitation probability P = clamp(40 + 1.5·Q - 8·LI, 5, 99); precipitation intensity R = max(0, 0.8·(Q-5) - 1.2·LI) mm/h. The larger Q is, the more abundant the moisture, and the more negative LI is, the more unstable, the higher the precipitation probability.
map.抬升指数 LI 为 500hPa 环境温度与气块温度之差，负值表示不稳定: The lifted index LI is the difference between the 500 hPa environmental temperature and the parcel temperature; a negative value indicates instability
map.水汽通量反映整层水汽输送强度，夏季典型值 10-30 g/(cm·hPa·s): The water vapor flux reflects the column moisture transport intensity, with typical summer values of 10-30 g/(cm·hPa·s)
map.本公式为经验统计模型，实际降水还受触发机制、地形等影响: This formula is an empirical statistical model; actual precipitation is also affected by triggering mechanisms, terrain and more
map.由历史相似天气的降雨频率估今日降水概率。: Estimate today's precipitation probability from the rain frequency of historically similar weather.
map.数值模式多个成员降水占比作概率。: Use the fraction of ensemble members with precipitation as the probability.
map.给「30% 降水」通俗解读。: Give a plain-language interpretation of "30% precipitation".
map.过去 100 个「相似环流+湿度」日中有 70 天下雨 → 降水概率≈70%，建: Of the past 100 days of "similar circulation + humidity", 70 had rain → precipitation probability ≈70%; advise bringing an umbrella.
map.数值模式 20 个成员里 6 个报雨 → 概率 30%，属「可能下但不大」，按活: Of the 20 ensemble members, 6 forecast rain → probability 30%, meaning "possibly but unlikely", decide by the importance of the activity.
map.降水概率 30% 是什么意思？: What does a 30% precipitation probability mean?
map.指预报区域内任一地点下雨的可能性 30%，不是「下 30% 时间/面积」。: It means a 30% chance of rain at any point in the forecast area, not "raining for 30% of the time/area".
map.不能简单相加；不同来源概率需看同一口径（地点/时段）。: They cannot be simply added; probabilities from different sources must use the same basis (location/time window).
map.输入整层水汽通量与抬升指数（LI），综合水汽输送条件与大气层结稳定度，估算降水发: Enter the column-integrated water vapor flux and the lifted index (LI) to estimate the probability of precipitation and its intensity magnitude, combining moisture transport conditions and atmospheric stratification stability, providing a reference for precipitation nowcasting.
